messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.r@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimbus.ai>, Nimbus Sales <sales@nimbus.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 roadmap exceptions: triage and exec clarifications

Team —

Quick follow-up after this morning's cross-functional sync. I consolidated the open "exceptions" we flagged and annotated where I need exec-level clarity for QBR materials. Attached is the tracker (CSV) with current owners and impact estimates. Please read the short notes below and reply with firm owners / ETA by EOD so I can finalize slides.

Summary of open exceptions (short):
- Nimbus Analytics integration (MALP): delayed due to additional security review; potential SLA exception request if we keep original GA date. Impact: could push ARR recognition into Q1. Owner: Lauren (tech), Marissa (commercial).
- Deduped-embedding pipeline: edge-case bug causing 0.1% loss in similarity recall; root cause suspected in preprocessor. Impact: affects search recall tests for one pilot customer. Owner: Aditya (infra).
- Dedicated capacity burst policy: policy mismatch for EU region customers; needs legal sign-off on cross-border logging. Owner: Marissa.

Asks (what I need from each of you):
- Lauren: confirm whether Nimbus security items can be mitigated with a scoped POA (proof-of-action) by Dec 10 or whether we need to escalate for an SLA exception. If escalation, call out exactly which controls are missing.
- Marissa: update commercial language and revenue impact estimate in the tracker (column: "QBR_impact_USD") and attach the latest Nimbus proposal.
- Aditya: give a short remediation plan and ETA for the embedding dedupe issue (preferably a patch + rollout timeline).

Notes for QBR slides: if we anticipate an SLA exception, we need an approval note from Eng + Legal + Sales. Aditya — please coordinate with SRE for rollback/mitigation notes.

I attached the tracker and also linked the working doc on Drive. I'll be building the executive slide deck on Monday; need final numbers by COB Dec 4 to include in the pre-read.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_exceptions_tracker.csv (spreadsheet, 12KB), Nimbus_MALP_proposal.pdf (pdf, 480KB)

On Fri, Dec 4, 2027 at 9:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Team —
> Quick follow-up after this morning's cross-functional sync. I consolidated the open "exceptions"...

Thanks Vivek — quick updates inline:

- Nimbus MALP: security has identified two missing items — (1) customer-managed KMS key handling for the KV cache, (2) audit log redaction for PII slices. Both are scoped; we can ship mitigations as config flags. I estimate a PR + staged rollout by Dec 9 if we prioritize. If we cannot ship by Dec 9, we should ask for a short SLA exception (1 quarter) and commit the mitigations by Jan 15.

- Deduped-embedding pipeline: reproduced; root cause is a race in the dedupe index rebuild during heavy writes. Working on a conservative lock + background rebuild approach; ETA for patch is Dec 11. Will coordinate with Aditya on rollout windows.

I updated the tracker with the technical mitigation notes (see attached row).

Lauren
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

Vivek / team —

I pulled the commercial impact numbers into the tracker and attached an updated PDF of the Nimbus proposal with suggested contract language for a scoped SLA exception (see attachment stub). Highlights:

- Nimbus ARR at risk: $480k if GA slips beyond Dec. Our suggested compromise: allow a 90-day exception window with milestone-based billing holdback (15%).
- EU logging: legal suggests a minimal change to the retention clause and a cross-border appendix; that can be finalized next week.

Action items I took in the tracker:
- Set "owner_sales" = Marissa Cole; ETA for final language Dec 8.
- Requested legal draft for EU appendix (assigned to Legal Ops).

Cc: Legal Ops <legal.ops@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 roadmap exceptions: triage and exec clarifications

Folks —

Thanks — quick callout from SRE/infra side: the dedupe race can be mitigated with a config toggle that serializes index rebuilds, but that will add a small tail-latency penalty for heavy write windows. Proposed plan:

1) Ship conservative lock + background rebuild (patch) by Dec 11.
2) Rollout to canary customers Dec 12–13.
3) Monitor recall metrics and rollback if >0.3% regression.

If the canary looks stable we can schedule full rollout in the Dec 20 maintenance window. If not, we will need to request an operational exception for affected customers for Q4.

Separately: on Nimbus SLA exception — I support the scoped exception approach but we need a legal sign-off and SRE-runbook entry before exec approves. Suggest we set a 30-minute decision call tomorrow at 10am PST to lock this.

Aditya Rao
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
